l3_car_t_second_line.quote: proceed directly to CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy, using axicabtagene ciloleucel as my choice

l3_why_early_relapse.quote: relapsing only about 3 months after completion of first-line Pola-R-CHP, i.e. early relapse on the primary-refractory spectrum, which is exactly the population in which ZUMA-7 and TRANSFORM showed CAR-T to be superior

l3_cd19_confirmed.quote: CD19-positive tumor by immunohistochemistry and flow, and good caregiver support

l3_no_more_drugs.quote: I advise against adding more empiric drugs now.

l3_avoid_bendamustine.quote: I would avoid bendamustine- or fludarabine-containing bridging and avoid multiple cycles that could compromise his fitness.

l3_ngs_interpretation.quote: This is a typical germinal-center-derived epigenetic and immune-evasion profile. There is no TP53 mutation, no MYD88 or CD79B mutation

l3_tazemetostat_context.quote: tazemetostat is approved for EZH2-mutant relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma, not DLBCL; EZH2 inhibitors in DLBCL remain investigational and would be considered only on a clinical trial or in a later line

l3_mn_rice_asct_preferred.quote: I would not choose an ASCT-based second-line strategy first in this early-relapse patient.

l3_mn_tazemetostat_instead.quote: not instead of or before CAR-T
